title: Table metadata
description: The <name>.meta.toml beside each <name>.csv: which part class the rows are, where every value comes from, and notes. A value's source is, in this order: a [[provenance]] entry naming its row and column, the row's `source` column, the table's default_source.

table.description: A table of the class other than its parts themselves: a name in the class schema's $defs.

key.description: The columns that together name a row; no two rows may have the same.

default_source.description: The source of every value that names no other.

notes.description: What a reader of the table needs to know: what a row is, the conditions of the values, and what was kept as printed although it looks wrong.

document.description: Maker, title, document number: enough to find the document again.

date.description: The document's edition (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), or the day of a measurement.

locator.description: Where in the document: chapter, page, table.

method.description: How the values got here: `script:<path>` (an extraction script of tools/), `manual: <how>` (typed in from the document), `measured: <how>`, or `[estimate] <reason>`.

rows.description: The rows by their key, the key columns joined by '|'; "*" for every row.
